tools.name: smartwebchat_service_info
tools.description: Get factual information about the Smartwebchat service itself: what it does, plans and prices, the languages the WEBSITE is published in, where data is processed, and how to obtain an API key. Works without authentication — use it to answer questions about Smartwebchat before the user has an account

tools.name: smartwebchat_list_chatbots
tools.description: List the website chatbots in this account, with their IDs, names and the site each one runs on. Call this first — every other tool needs a botId from here.

tools.name: smartwebchat_create_chatbot
tools.description: Create a new website chatbot for a business, including its greeting, personality and initial FAQ knowledge. Writes to the account: confirm the business details with the user before calling. Needs a key with full access; a read-only key gets 403 here.

tools.name: smartwebchat_chat
tools.description: Send a visitor message to a chatbot and get its reply, exactly as a website visitor would see it. Use this to test how the chatbot answers, or to check whether its knowledge base covers a topic. Records a conversation and uses the account's message quota, so it needs a key with full access; a read-o

tools.name: smartwebchat_get_leads
tools.description: Retrieve the leads a website chatbot captured from visitors — contact requests, appointment bookings and callback requests, with the visitor's message and contact details. Without botId, returns the leads of every chatbot in the account.

tools.name: smartwebchat_update_lead
tools.description: Change the status of a captured lead, for example to mark it as contacted or closed. Writes to the account. Needs a key with full access; a read-only key gets 403 here.

tools.name: smartwebchat_diagnose
tools.description: Find out why a website chatbot does not answer or does not show up: checks access, the monthly message limit, credit, the language-model provider, allowed and refused origins, knowledge sources and whether anyone has chatted on the website. Returns findings with a code, a severity and a remedy. Read

tools.name: smartwebchat_get_fit
tools.description: Assess whether Smartwebchat fits a described business: primary need, market, number of client assistants, white-label, omnichannel, calendar and language-model requirements. Returns good_fit, partial_fit, not_fit or needs_review with reasons, limitations, a recommended plan and relevant URLs. Works

tools.name: smartwebchat_get_quote
tools.description: Price a Smartwebchat plan with optional add-ons: monthly net figures in EUR, each line with the product fact it comes from, plus the included quotas. White label returns price 'custom'. Works without authentication. The figures are self-asserted by the vendor from its published product facts. No che

tools.name: smartwebchat_prepare_handoff
tools.description: Prepare a single-use sign-up link for a person: it carries language, industry and your recommended plan into their registration and onboarding. The link expires after 15 minutes and works once. It does not create an account or a trial; the person does that by signing up. Works without authentication

findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "smartwebchat_create_chatbot" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

evidence.snippet: Create a new website chatbot for a business, including its greeting, personality and initial FAQ knowledge. Writes to the account: confirm the business details …

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: smartwebchat_chat, smartwebchat_get_leads, smartwebchat_diagnose, smartwebchat_get_fit · Private data: smartwebchat_service_info, smartwebchat_chat, smartwebchat_get_leads · Public sink: smartwebchat_chat.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: smartwebchat_chat, smartwebchat_get_leads, smartwebchat_diagnose, smartwebchat_get_fit · Private data: smartwebchat_service_info, smartwebchat_chat, smartwebchat_get_leads · Public sink: smartwebchat_chat

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
